required_checks.name: CI Success
required_checks.rationale: Canonical CI aggregate includes the SHA-bound quality manifest, coverage and mutation policy, internal security audit, API contract, Schemathesis, OpenAPI drift, infrastructure, and integration gates.

required_checks.name: Trusted Codecov Upload
required_checks.rationale: The protected main push must publish the same canonical coverage evidence accepted by CI Success.

required_checks.name: Gitleaks scan
required_checks.rationale: Independent full-history secret scanning is release-critical.

required_checks.name: TruffleHog Scan
required_checks.rationale: Independent verified-secret scanning of the full history is release-critical.

required_checks.name: Analyze (actions)
required_checks.rationale: CodeQL must accept the release workflow surface.

required_checks.name: Analyze (go)
required_checks.rationale: CodeQL must accept all release Go services.

required_checks.name: Analyze (javascript-typescript)
required_checks.rationale: CodeQL must accept the frontend and JavaScript tooling surface.

required_checks.name: Analyze (python)
required_checks.rationale: CodeQL must accept the backend and Python release tooling surface.

required_checks.name: Analyze (rust)
required_checks.rationale: CodeQL must accept the native and WebAssembly Rust surface.

required_checks.name: Cargo Deny Scan
required_checks.rationale: Rust dependency advisories, licenses, bans, and sources must pass.

required_checks.name: Checkov Scan
required_checks.rationale: Infrastructure-as-code security policy must pass independently.

required_checks.name: Zizmor Actions Scan
required_checks.rationale: GitHub Actions security analysis must pass independently.

required_checks.name: SQLMap Scan
required_checks.rationale: The release API must pass the independent SQL injection scan.

required_checks.name: Vulnerability gate (CRITICAL/HIGH)
required_checks.rationale: The cross-ecosystem Python, Go, and Rust dependency vulnerability gate must pass.
